name: Windsor Court Hotel
insider_take: This elegant riverside sanctuary channels the grandeur of a European palace while capturing the soulful essence of the Big Easy.
whats_special: Home to one of the world's largest private collections of 17th-19th century art, the Windsor Court houses over $7 million worth of museum-quality pieces throughout its halls. The hotel sits just steps from the historic French Quarter and features the only AAA Five Diamond spa in Louisiana.
pro_tip: Book a Mississippi River-view suite during sunset – the golden hour reflections off the water create an unforgettable backdrop, and you might catch a steamboat passing by with live jazz echoing across the river.
dont_miss: The legendary afternoon tea service in the Le Salon lobby, featuring live harp music and three-tiered silver stands. Also explore the nearby Warehouse District's world-class museums, including the National WWII Museum, all within a pleasant 10-minute stroll.
pros: Exceptional white-glove service with personalized attention
Prime French Quarter location within walking distance of top attractions
Award-winning Grill Room restaurant with fine dining experience
Elegant European-style décor with museum-quality art collection
Spacious suites with marble bathrooms and luxury amenities
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
